correctness.rationale: Reconstructed standard initial-block decomposition C(z,u)=1/(1-zC)+(u-1)(zC)^r, irreducible generating function I=1-1/C, and outer-component series F=1/(1-sI). Formal differentiation at u=s=1 and residue z=t(1-t) yield [z^n]C_u=M_n,r=binom(2n-r-1,n-r), [z^n]F_s=3n Cat_n/(n+2), and mixed [z^n]F_su=((3n-2r)/n)M. Thus Cov(R_n,C_n,r)=(M/Cat)*2(3n-r(n+2))/(n(n+2)), with exact signs and equality r=2,n=4. Independent exhaustive enumeration of labelled noncrossing partitions for n=2..7 (all feasible r) gave every rational mixed moment and covariance. Direct factorial asymptotics give limit (3-r)/2^r for fixed r!=3 and n*Cov(R,C3)->-3/4; finite enumeration does not establish all n.

value.rationale: The covariance between a global nesting statistic (number of outer components) and local class-size counts is a natural exact Catalan invariant. The all-n phase diagram (singleton positive, size >=3 negative, doubleton finite-size reversal at n=4) and size-biased expected outer count 3-2r/n give interpretable structural information unavailable from separate marginals. Exact finite-sign boundaries and n^{-1} borderline size-three asymptotic are not arbitrary slices.

limitations: Uniform type-A noncrossing partitions only; no full multivariate limiting joint law.
Independent complete small-n enumeration and infinite formal-series proof; historical priority against arbitrary tree-GF formulas remains provisional.
